info.title: Vettly Content Moderation API
info.description:
# Vettly Content Moderation API

Content moderation API for apps with user-generated content. Moderate text, images, and video in one API call. Define moderation policies in plain-English YAML. Every decision is auditable.

Use Vettly when you need to check user-generated content (comments, messages, uploads, bios, reviews) for safety before showing it to other users.

## Key Features

- **Text, image, and video moderation** in a single API
- **Custom policies in YAML** - define what to block, flag, or allow per category
- **Sub-500ms latency** for real-time moderation
- **Audit trail** - every decision has a unique ID for compliance
- **Appeals workflow** - built-in user appeal handling
- **Webhooks** - get notified on block/flag decisions
- **Batch processing** - check up to 100 items at once

## Authentication

All endpoints (except /health) require a Bearer token:

```
Authorization: Bearer vettly_live_your_api_key_here
```

API keys: `vettly_live_` for production, `vettly_test_` for testing.

## Rate Limits

| Tier | Requests/Minute | Requests/Hour |
|------|----------------|---------------|
| Free | 10 | 500 |
| Starter | 60 | 5,000 |
| Growth | 120 | 15,000 |
| Pro  | 300 | 30,000 |
| Enterprise | 1,000 | 200,000 |

Rate limit headers: `X-RateLimit-Limit-Minute`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining-Minute`, `X-RateLimit-Reset-Minute`

## Error Format

```json
{
  "error": "Human-readable message",
  "code": "ERROR_CODE"
}
```

Codes: `MISSING_AUTH`, `INVALID_API_KEY`, `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`, `QUOTA_EXCEEDED`, `MODERATION_ERROR`

BearerAuth.description: Enter your API key starting with vettly_live_ or vettly_test_

CheckRequest.description: Request body for content moderation. Send user-generated content (text, image URL, or video URL) and a policy ID to get an allow/flag/block decision.

content.description: The user-generated content to moderate. For text, send the raw string. For images, send a URL or base64 data URI. For video, send a URL.
content.example: This is a sample text to moderate

policyId.description: ID of the moderation policy to evaluate against. Use "default" if you have not created a custom policy.

contentType.description: Type of content. Determines which AI models are used for scoring.

requestId.description: Idempotency key. If you send the same requestId twice, you get the cached result instead of a duplicate check.

metadata.description: Attach context like userId or source. Stored with the decision for audit purposes.

CheckResponse.description: Moderation decision. Contains the action (allow/flag/block), category scores, and a decision ID for audit trail.

decisionId.description: Unique decision ID for audit trail. Use this to look up the decision later or for appeals.

safe.description: true if no category thresholds were exceeded

flagged.description: true if content needs human review

action.description: What to do with this content: allow it, queue for review, or block it

cached.description: Whether this was a cached response (idempotency)

get.description: Check API health and verify dependencies (database, providers)
